    The Hochschild complex of OP in one character #

    integral-deformations.tex: "We put A^{(2)} = 𝔽₂P and A^{(4)} = 𝒪P; all cochains are normalized relative to the vertex identities and respect the categorical grading and the integer ray weights."

    For a ray system with weights and a character χ, a normalized relative cochain of character χ on the linearization OP (any commutative ring O) sends a composable pair of nonidentity rays (u, v) to a multiple of the ray w₂(u, v) with the endpoints of uv and weight ℓ(u) + ℓ(v) + χ (unique by sep). Such cochains are coefficient functions on the pairs for which w₂ exists (C2); one-cochains are coefficient functions on the shiftable rays (C1). Their realizations Φ₁, Φ₂ as linear and bilinear maps of OP, and the coboundary d₁ in coefficients (d1), with hcobdry (Φ₁ f) = Φ₂ (d₁ f).
